{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Heath Mello has been reported as an anti-abortion, anti-choice candidate.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Wall Street Journal stated that Heath Mello, as a practicing Catholic, was pro-life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In 2012, Heath Mello voted with Planned Parenthood on two out of three bills tracked by the group and was excused from voting on the third.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"After 2012, Heath Mello, as chair of the state legislature’s budget committee, voted with Planned Parenthood 100 percent of the time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Heath Mello’s votes contributed to a four-year period without any new laws regulating abortion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To build a strong national movement for liberation in a complicated world, the group should trust its grassroots.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Critics of Sanders and Mello failed to object to Tim Kaine, who had a consistent voting record for supporting laws that limited access to abortions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group reaffirms its commitment to reproductive justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Some attacks on Sanders are potentially cynical attempts to undermine a politician who challenges the ruling class.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
